video_title: Scottie Barnes | Post Game vs Orlando Magic | October 30, 2026

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his aggressive offensive mindset
quotes.excerpt: My mindset going into a game now is just keep trying to be aggressive as best as I can.
quotes.quote: I think I just been trying to be aggressive, especially at the Minnesota game for sure. So I think my mindset going into a game now is just keep trying to be aggressive as best as I can, help the team out as much as I can.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says his current mindset is focused on staying aggressive to help the team, noting he has been trying to maintain that intensity since the Minnesota game.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes discusses his offensive mindset following the game against the Orlando Magic.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on balancing perimeter shooting and attacking the rim
quotes.excerpt: The difference is being able to get to those spots but also being aggressive going to the rim.
quotes.quote: I think I been getting to my spots pretty good. The difference is being able to get to those spots but also being aggressive going to the rim. So not always settling, but just still trying to be aggressive, go to the rim, go to people's chest, be able to get to a paint touch, draw the defense in. If the shot's there, probably the dunk is there. If the whole defense collapses, find the corner, but just trying to mix in both.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes explains his offensive approach, saying he is working on balancing perimeter shots with attacking the rim to draw the defense and create opportunities for teammates.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes explains his approach to balancing perimeter shooting and attacking the rim during the post-game press conference.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on RJ Barrett's performance and rebounding
quotes.excerpt: They were trying to be more aggressive on RJ because of the last game with his pick and rolls.
quotes.quote: I think we were just playing basketball. I think he was rebounding the ball pretty good. I think when we were driving, they were trying to be more aggressive on RJ because of the last game with his pick and rolls. They were trying to be more like a soft blitz on him. Obviously, I think I was getting downhill, so find him under the dunker. I think he was open a lot, but you know, I think he was doing a great job of rebounding and trying to be physical as much as we can.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes notes that defenses are adjusting to RJ Barrett with soft blitzes, forcing the Raptors to find him in the dunker spot while emphasizing the need for physical rebounding.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes comments on RJ Barrett's performance and rebounding during the game against Orlando.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his career-high scoring night
quotes.excerpt: I think before the season I wanted to break that, but it's just about trying to be aggressive.
quotes.quote: By now I don't know. I think I got to let some time grow off. I think for sure before the season I wanted to break that, but it's just about trying to be aggressive. I think I did a great job of going downhill, being aggressive. Definitely think I could have got to the free throw line more. Being that aggressive, only shooting three free throws is kind of crazy, but it just wasn't going our way.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes reflects on his scoring night, saying he believes he could have gotten to the free throw line more often despite his aggressive downhill play.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes reflects on his career-high scoring performance and his ability to get to the free throw line.

quotes.speaker: Scottie Barnes
quotes.summary_phrase: Scottie Barnes on his late-game injury
quotes.excerpt: I forgot what move I did. I just tried to get it off the backboard because I didn't really have my balance.
quotes.quote: I forgot what move I did. I just tried to get it off the backboard because I didn't really have my balance. Got a putback dunk, didn't go in our favor again. I mean, didn't go in our favor, but I think when I was coming down, I hit his head and it kind of just hit my funny bone. So my whole arm and hand kind of went numb, can't really feel anything. It still hurts a little bit right now, but I think it'll get better. I just hit my funny bone.
quotes.social_post: Scottie Barnes says his arm and hand went numb after hitting his funny bone during a late game play, adding that it still hurts but he expects it to get better.

structured.context: Scottie Barnes explains how he injured his arm and hand during a play in the game against the Orlando Magic.
